questions.question_text: What is the primary purpose of researching potential careers and job profiles?

options.text: To immediately decide on a lifelong career path
To gather detailed information about roles and see if they align with your skills and interests
To impress potential employers with your knowledge
To avoid taking career assessments like Holland Codes

correct_answer.text: To gather detailed information about roles and see if they align with your skills and interests

questions.question_text: What does the Holland Code (RIASEC) assessment primarily help you identify?

options.text: The exact salary you will earn in a specific career
Your personality type and matching career categories based on interests
The best college major for your future job
How to write a resume for job applications

correct_answer.text: Your personality type and matching career categories based on interests

questions.question_text: If your Holland Code result is “SAE” (Social, Artistic, Enterprising), which career might be a good match?

options.text: Software Engineer
Event Planner
Automotive Technician
Data Analyst

questions.question_text: When evaluating a career’s working conditions, what factor should you consider to ensure it fits your lifestyle?

options.text: The company’s stock price
Whether the job offers a fast-paced or relaxed environment and matches your preferred work hours
The number of social media followers the job role typically has
The color of the office walls

correct_answer.text: Whether the job offers a fast-paced or relaxed environment and matches your preferred work hours

questions.question_text: Why is it important to research salary data for a career using tools like BLS.gov or Glassdoor.com?

options.text: To compare it with your friends’ earnings
To determine if the starting pay and growth potential can support your financial needs and goals
To decide if you should ask for a raise immediately
To know how much to spend on work clothes

correct_answer.text: To determine if the starting pay and growth potential can support your financial needs and goals

questions.question_text: What makes a career “future-proof” as discussed in the chapter?

options.text: It guarantees a high salary from the start
It is expected to grow and remain relevant due to global trends like technology and sustainability
It requires no education or training to enter
It is a traditional job that has existed for centuries

correct_answer.text: It is expected to grow and remain relevant due to global trends like technology and sustainability

questions.question_text: Which of the following is an example of a future-proof career in the Green Energy sector, and why?

options.text: Coal Miner, because it’s a hands-on job
Solar Photovoltaic Installer, because of high growth due to sustainability goals
Travel Blogger, because it involves outdoor work
Retail Cashier, because it’s in high demand everywhere

correct_answer.text: Solar Photovoltaic Installer, because of high growth due to sustainability goals

questions.question_text: How can combining insights from a Holland Code assessment and research on future-proof careers help in career planning?

options.text: It ensures you pick the highest-paying job immediately
It helps you identify careers that match your personality while focusing on growing, relevant fields
It eliminates the need to evaluate job tasks or salary data
It guarantees you’ll get hired in your chosen field

correct_answer.text: It helps you identify careers that match your personality while focusing on growing, relevant fields
